ActivitiesPage.title: Things to Do in Minneapolis and St. Paul

card-1.title: Eat Street
card-1.description: A diverse collection of international restaurants
card-1.details: Explore a wide variety of cuisines from around the world on Nicollet Avenue, known locally as 'Eat Street'. From Vietnamese pho to German schnitzel, there's something for every palate.
card-1.cost: Varies by restaurant, generally $10-$30 per person

card-2.title: Midtown Global Market
card-2.details: Visit this vibrant marketplace featuring food vendors, restaurants, and unique gifts from around the world. Don't miss the opportunity to try foods from various cultures all under one roof.

card-3.title: St. Paul Farmers' Market
card-3.description: Fresh local produce and artisanal goods
card-3.details: Experience the best of Minnesota's local produce and artisanal products at this historic farmers' market. Open year-round, it's a great place to sample fresh foods and meet local producers.
card-3.cost: Free entry, prices vary by vendor

card-4.title: Myriel
card-4.description: Intimate Dining Comes With a Cup of Egg Coffee
card-4.details: The a la carte menu isn't available online because it changes often. Tomlinson makes a famous crust: If apple pie appears on the menu, order it without hesitation, and pair dessert with a Scandinavian egg coffee.

card-1.title: Minneapolis Institute of Art
card-1.description: World-class art museum with free admission
card-1.details: Explore over 90,000 works of art spanning 5,000 years of human creativity. From ancient artifacts to contemporary masterpieces, MIA offers a diverse and enriching experience for art lovers.
card-1.cost: Free general admission, some special exhibitions may have a fee

card-2.title: Mall of America
card-2.description: Largest shopping mall in the United States
card-2.details: More than just shopping, the Mall of America features an indoor amusement park, aquarium, and countless entertainment options. It's a city within a city and a must-visit attraction.
card-2.cost: Free entry, costs vary for attractions and shopping

card-3.title: Minnehaha Falls
card-3.details: Enjoy the natural beauty of Minnehaha Falls, located in Minnehaha Park. Take a scenic hike, have a picnic, or simply relax by the cascading water in this urban oasis.

card-4.title: Science Museum of Minnesota
card-4.description: Interactive science museum with stunning river views
card-4.details: Engage with hands-on exhibits, catch a show at the Omnitheater, and learn about everything from dinosaurs to the human body. The museum offers spectacular views of the Mississippi River.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: This Privacy Policy describes how we protect your privacy when you use our website and mobile application. We are committed to safeguarding the privacy of our website visitors, app users, and service users.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.description: Our website does not collect personal information from visitors. We do not use cookies or tracking technologies to monitor browsing behavior on our website.

appData.title: App-Specific Information
appData.description: Our mobile application collects limited personal information including your name and profile photo to enhance your user experience. This information is stored securely and is only used for the purpose of personalizing your app experience.
appData.additionalInfo: Beyond this basic profile information, our app does not collect device information, location data, or access other services on your device. We only require permissions necessary for core app functionality.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.description: The name and profile photo you provide in our app are only used to personalize your experience within the app. This information is not used for marketing purposes or behavioral analysis.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.description: We do not share, sell, rent, or trade any user information with third parties for their commercial purposes. Your name and photo remain private within our application and are not shared externally.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
dataDeletion.description: You can request the deletion of your profile information at any time by contacting us. Upon account deletion, all personal information including your name and photo will be permanently removed from our systems.

security.title: Security
security.description: We take reasonable precautions to protect your information. While we use standard security practices, no internet, electronic storage method, or mobile application is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the app if applicable.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us.
